text: Spoke with Tom about renewing their annual contract. He mentioned they are expanding the team by 12 people next quarter and will need additional seats.

text: Tom requested a walkthrough of the new reporting dashboard. Scheduled for Thursday at 2pm. He wants to bring their ops director.
